gmail.reason: The Gmail MCP toolset available this run exposed only update_draft (requires an existing draft ID), get_draft, delete_draft, send_message, reply, forward, update_message_labels, and spam/trash operations — no create_draft or list_drafts tool. There was no way to create a brand-new draft from scratch. Per the routine's explicit instruction to draft (not send), no live email was sent as a workaround.
gmail.recommendedFix: Reconnect/upgrade the Gmail connector for this Routine so it exposes a create_draft (or equivalent compose) tool, or have a human draft these 3 alert emails + the weekly digest manually from the alert files and digest-pending.md, then clear digest-pending.md.
